llm.summary: This skill looks like a small local CLI, but it stores user-supplied data and command history on disk without clearly disclosing that behavior.

dimensions.detail: The script creates a data directory under BOILERPLATES_DIR or the user's local data home and writes data.log and history.log, which is broader than an output-only template helper.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package ships local shell scripts and no remote installer, dependencies, network retrieval, or privilege-escalation mechanism was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md documents only help, run, info, and status and uses broad command wording; the richer command set and side effects are only visible in the script help text.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent plaintext storage of entries and first command arguments is under-disclosed, has no retention control, and does not set restrictive file permissions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose is a personal boilerplate/template collection, while artifact/scripts/script.sh implements a broader multi-purpose command utility with add, list, search, export, and history logging.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Avoid entering secrets or sensitive project details into this tool unless you are comfortable with them being retained in local plaintext files, and prefer a version that documents its storage behavior and narrows the command set to actual boilerplate management.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Supported by artifact evidence: the script behaves as a local data/history utility rather than just a passive template collection.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Supported in part: the documented command scope is vague and incomplete compared with the script's actual command set.
[EA1] expected: Downgraded: the wording is broad, but the script uses an allowlisted case dispatcher and does not execute arbitrary shell commands.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Supported: add/list/search/export data operations and persistent logs are materially different from the declared template collection purpose.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Supported: the script describes itself as a multi-purpose utility while the skill metadata describes boilerplate templates.
[T09] unexpected: Supported: user-supplied entries and first arguments are written to plaintext local logs; missing argument handling and grep option handling are lower-impact reliability issues.
